Research programme · 04

Embodied Intelligence: Trustworthy Multimodal Robotics

How can intelligent agents remain safe when perception becomes physical action?

Trust mechanisms for vision-language-action models and embodied agents, including inference-time safeguards, adversarial testing, and physical-world backdoors.

Research focus

Three questions shape this programme.

This is the working agenda: a precise statement of the problems the lab is building toward, not a claim that every component is already solved.

01

Inference-time safeguards

Detect and regulate unsafe concepts while an embodied policy is deciding what action to take.

02

Adversarial VLA evaluation

Expose model-agnostic failure modes across vision, language, and action interfaces.

03

Physical-world threat models

Study how ordinary-looking objects and environmental cues can trigger goal-directed unsafe behaviour.
